items.name: v1.128.0
items.body:
## Changelog   
### ✨ Features   
* **feat(deploy-token):** Add the delete command ([171edc5a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/171edc5a)) by Paweł Farys<!--community-->   
* **feat(df):** fetch Go modules through the user's own GOPROXY ([a8b66b25](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a8b66b25)) by Arpit Gogia<!--community-->   
* **feat(df):** support registries behind an upstream proxy ([199f034a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/199f034a)) by Ryan Wells<!--team-->   
* **feat(govern):** redact common secret formats before uploading sessions ([e79373a1](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/e79373a1)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
### 🐛 Bug Fixes   
* **fix(api):** offer only HTTP/1.1 to HTTPS proxies ([2ca9e118](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/2ca9e118)) by Arpit Gogia<!--community-->   
* **fix(config):** keep glab-managed keys in the global config ([289f000f](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/289f000f)) by Jeston Singh<!--community-->   
* **fix(df):** warn once per registry when a registry request fails ([02d9f1ce](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/02d9f1ce)) by Arpit Gogia<!--community-->   
* **fix(git):** keep the first HostName for an SSH host alias ([5ce7dc9b](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/5ce7dc9b)) by José M. Requena Plens<!--community-->   
* **fix(govern):** don't skip a Claude Code transcript entry still being written ([055141e1](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/055141e1)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **fix(markdown):** preserve hard line breaks ([dc2ea409](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/dc2ea409)) by Zaygal<!--community-->   
* **fix(project):** show the real total in the contributors list header ([a7bb4af9](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a7bb4af9)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **fix(release):** preserve description and name when omitted on update ([6a3bcf71](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/6a3bcf71)) by Abdelrahman Megahed<!--community-->   
* **fix(user):** show the real total in the user events header ([0de5b6f8](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/0de5b6f8)) by unstable-code<!--community-->   
### 📝 Documentation   
* **docs(skills):** use --description-file and stdin instead of nested heredocs ([ca3e4aea](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/ca3e4aea)) by Andrei Zubov<!--team-->   
### 🔧 Maintenance   
* **refactor(packages):** deprecate the rm alias of delete in favour of del ([9f7f7a3e](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/9f7f7a3e)) by Tomas Vik<!--team-->   
### 📦 Dependencies   
* **chore(deps):** update module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3 to v3.42.0 ([2350dad6](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/2350dad6)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->

items.body:
## Changelog   
### ✨ Features

* **feat(deploy-token):** Add the create command ([d0bb4dc1](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/d0bb4dc1)) by Paweł Farys<!--community-->   
* **feat(deploy-token):** Add the get command ([4df8498a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/4df8498a)) by Paweł Farys<!--community-->   
* **feat(duo):** support Duo CLI v10 auto-updates ([735c92fe](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/735c92fe)) by Tomas Vik<!--team-->   
* **feat(govern):** choose which agents glab govern setup sets up ([6488ba9d](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/6488ba9d)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->

* **feat(work-items):** add --parent flag to create and update ([557881b4](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/557881b4)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **feat(work-items):** add date filters to list ([0d65c92c](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/0d65c92c)) by Radek Antoniuk<!--community-->   
* **feat:** added the Software Factory configuration file ([3c4a9a4f](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/3c4a9a4f)) by Denys Mishunov<!--team-->   
### 🐛 Bug Fixes   
* fix(mr issue): limit concurrent lookups in bulk commands ([20807603](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/20807603)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->

* **fix(release):** report a failed close and remove a partial asset ([02fd67e6](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/02fd67e6)) by Kai Armstrong<!--team-->   
* **fix:** aligned non-TTY output without being truncated ([a5ae8a5a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a5ae8a5a)) by Syed Saif Ali Alvi<!--community-->

* **docs(auth):** recommend glab as Git credential helper on OAuth-only instances ([88a9afeb](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/88a9afeb)) by Abdelrahman Megahed<!--community-->   
### 🔧 Maintenance   
* **chore(lint):** report every issue instead of a truncated sample ([0f19cc0b](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/0f19cc0b)) by Cian<!--community-->   
* **chore:** let gitlab-bot approve docs changes ([08ffbf67](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/08ffbf67)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
### 📦 Dependencies   
* **chore(deps):** update module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3 to v3.39.2 ([acd63fe4](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/acd63fe4)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3 to v3.40.0 ([2e38182b](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/2e38182b)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3 to v3.40.2 ([f48ea2bc](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/f48ea2bc)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
* **chore(deps):** update module go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 to v3.0.6 ([7b012455](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/7b012455)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->   
### 🔀 Others   
* perf(mr view): skip fields and approval state the output doesn't use ([661eb14a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/661eb14a)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **test(govern):** widen timing margin in OpenCode child process test ([3206215f](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/3206215f)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **test(telemetry):** cover a leading repo override in command attribution ([2ba3f40d](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/2ba3f40d)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->

items.body:
## Changelog

* **chore(deps):** update module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/v3 to v3.39.1 ([b690423b](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/b690423b)) by GitLab Dependency Bot<!--team-->
